name: Necromancer: Skeletal Archers only shoot targets within 40 yards
contract: Animate: Skeletal Archer 805040 triggers 500330, which raises three Skeletal Archers (50076) for 15 s. A Skeletal Archer is a ranged minion without combat movement: it adopts its owner's target and fires its 800609 'Skeletal Arrow' every 3 s. Like the 40 yd 'Command: Skeletal Archers' 504319 (SpellRange 5) and the Frost Wyrm's breath targeting, an archer engages only an enemy within 40 yards and in line of sight, and it drops a target that leaves that reach so it can follow its owner's next target. The arrow's own 45 yd SpellRange 36 (plus the engine's 10 % cast leeway) does not set that reach. Players reported that archers kept shooting their old target at any distance until given a new one. The owner first attacks a golem 46 yards away: the archers do not adopt it and fire no arrow. The owner then attacks a golem 30 yards away: the archers adopt it and shoot it.
